notes.title: 0.75.4 Update - New Pixel, Quiver
notes.content:
0.75.4 Update - New Pixel, Quiver

Version 75.4 is now released! This update features a new Pixel, Quiver, new Equipment, Shop Overhaul and more! 

A lot of work was done to build up future infrastructure for updates coming down the pipeline. We hope you enjoy the new content as we continue to work on future updates!


Gameplay

 Quiver: Quiver is known for its cunning and inquisitive nature. It possesses a keen intellect and is always seeking new challenges, making it an adept problem solver. It is an excellent climber, allowing it to move gracefully through the treetops.
 Shop Overhaul: Shop has been updated to have a random selection of items. Once you purchase an item, it is now gone. Want to try your luck? Spend some cash to reroll for a chance to see the items you want!
 5 New Gear have been added

    New Gear: Poker Face Mask - Equipable gear. When a Pixel equipped with this enters the battle, it lowers the foe's ATK.
    New Gear: Unsettled Face Mask - Equipable gear. When a Pixel equipped with this enters the battle, it lowers the foe's SATK.
    New Gear: Velvet Hands - Equipable gear.  When equipped, money rewards are increased by 50%. A magical velvet scarf often used by thieves.
    New Gear: Boost Boots - Equipable gear. When in battle, Pixel's SPD increases at the end of every turn. These special boots weren't made for humans.
    New Gear: Poker Face Mask - Equipable gear. Voltage damage against this Pixel is ignored. Instead, the Pixel heals for 25% HP. A cheap looking necklace that turns energy into health.
  5 New Metameals have been added

 New Gear: Funky Donut - Equipable meal. When Pixel's HP drops below 60%, it restores 20% of its HP and PP. Can activate once per battle.
 New Gear: Pickle Mummy - Equipable meal. Pixel eats pickle when asleep, healing itself to full HP. Can activate once per battle.
 New Gear: Mr. Simley's Hot Sauce - Equipable meal. When entering battle, boosts the user's Fire moves but also applies BURN. Can activate once per battle.
 New Gear: Bit Onion - Equipable meal. If the foe used a physical attack this turn, reduce foe's ATK sharply. Can activate once per battle.
 New Gear: Fruity Smoothie - Equipable meal. If Pixel used a healing move this turn, heal 30% HP and increase DEF. Can activate once per battle.
 

Misc.

 Intro text for first zone added.
 Wing Jab Recoil Percentage 50% -> 30%

This update concludes the map of Zone 1 and we are excited to bring you new content soon!

notes.title: Pixels Update 0.73.1 - Featuring Sir Wiglliam, New Equipment, Status Effects
notes.content:
0.73.1 Update

Version 73.1 is now released! We have been working tirelessly since the last update was released and hope you enjoy the changes. This update features Sir Wiglliam, new Status Effects, Metameals, Gear, and more!  

Pixel

 New Pixel: Sir Wiglliam is the mech controlled by the Wiggles Jr., and species of Pixels specialized in health. Although Sir Wiglliam has no mind of its own, it simply responds to commands from a pilot like Wiggles Jr. The robot becomes indispensable once engaged in battle: it's strong and defensive as long as there is a competent driver hanging by its side.
 Batson got stylish and now has a hoody!


Equipment

10 New Equipment have been added!

5 New Metameals

 		Perfect Egg - Equipable meal. Eggs are loved by most Pixels, but no one knows who lays them. Fully restores the PP of an attack move when it reaches 0. Can be activated once per battle.
 		Juicy Burger - Equipable meal. A super delicious burger that will make the Pixel feel satisfied. If their HP drops below 50%, they will consume the burger to recover 27% HP. Can be activated once per battle.
 		Hot Dog Jerry - Equipable meal. A sentient hotdog meant to be eaten. Activates when the user is frozen and cures it. User can't be frozen for the rest of combat.
 		Marty Cookie - Equipable meal. A cookie in the shape of a Marty Martini! Activates when the holder is asleep and cures it. User can't be slept for the rest of combat.
 		Frozen Leftovers - Equipable meal. Someone ate the best part of this cake and saved it for later. Activates when the user suffers from burn. The User's burn is cured and can't be burned for the rest of combat.

5 New Gear

 		Ring of Vita - Equipable gear. A ring made by the dragon of vita, Mathilda. Wearing it will boost the Pixel's Water, Flora and Glitch moves.
 		Ring of Spirit - Equipable gear. A ring made by the dragon of spirit, Mathus. Wearing it will boost the Pixel's Flight, Weapon and Brawl moves.
 		Ring of Magic - Equipable gear. A ring made by the dragon of magic, Mchealos. Wearing it will boost the Pixel's Arcane, Cosmic and Medium moves.
 		Ring of Ore - Equipable gear. A ring made by the dragon of ore, Mathias. Wearing it will boost the Pixel's Earth, Metal and Mineral moves.
 		Ring of Power - Equipable gear. A ring made by the dragon of power, Matheus. Wearing it will boost the Pixel's Fire, Voltage, and Frost moves.


Gameplay

New Status Effects: Rage, Energize, and Force Shield


 	Rage - Pixel’s non-attack moves now cost 99. Lasts 3 turns.
 	Energize - Pixel's Voltage damage is increased by 20%. Lasts 3 turns.
 	Force Shield - The shield absorbs 20% of damage taken and reflects it back to the attacker. Lasts 3 turns.


Mystery Tiles


 Gambler tile -  Lootbox rewards have been updated, dice game wording now clearer.
 Item Replicator - UI and wording updated
 Converter tile - Updated with new feature "Convert Deluxe" which lets you pick from 3 random Pixels to convert to.


Misc.


 "Choose Pixel" Start Game Menu has been updated.
 Choose a reward UI has been updated
 Misc. other UI updates

notes.title: Update 0.70.0 Preview (Monkeye and Equipment System)
notes.content:
We have been hard at work on Update 0.70.0 and we're proud to annouce it is finally coming soon! Here is a preview of what to expect! Please look forward to a release at beginning of next month.

New Pixel - Monkeye (Voltage)

Monkeye is not a creature to be trifled with, and those who cross him or his loved ones may find themselves on the receiving end of his electric wrath. But for those who earn his trust and respect, Monkeye is a fierce and loyal ally, who will stop at nothing to protect them.

Monkeye is an agile Pixel who is our first Voltage type! While he has lower DEF and ATK, he makes up for it by having a higher speed and stronger SATK. We hope you enjoy using / fighting against him!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/59851deac0a65ec4f5da985996c3fcf0170079a3.png

Equipment System

While we currently have consumables in the game, we are excited to finally bring our Equipment system to Pixels! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/f05bb488f8a90c77634efcad8958b910585423d0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/93f052214f53e9fdc7d96d796cafd640eee7539d.png

Each Pixel can equip both a piece of gear and a metameal to power them up! Currently the gear system will be in update 0.70.0 but metameals will be coming in a future update! One example of a new piece of gear is the Rage Belt, a powerful item that adds additional power to your attacks. Please be on the lookout for new gears as we release future updates!

Mystery Event Adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/1eb48061200ee5a7e455415d91d61581b38ffead.png

Finally, we are doing some tweaks to the mystery events. We have a brand new UI update and are also tweaking some of the exisiting events to make them more interesting.

Thanks for checking out our Pixels DC Update Preview! 

- Jon

notes.title: Pixels Devlog #1 - Introducing New Pixels, Battle Cost System, New Event Tiles!
notes.content:
Hey all! Just wanted to provide an update on PIXELS as we move closer to our launch in Q2 this year. (Yes, thats real soon!!)

This is going to be the first of hopefully, constant annoucements as we get closer to Early Access release and beyond.

First of all, I wanted to give a thank you to all demo players and anyone who played, wishlisted, or watched our Stream during Feb's NextFest. We had a big boost during NextFest and it really means a lot to us so thank you!

Also a HUGE thank you to the people who provided feedback on the Steam forum. We took your feedback into consideration when working on new features. We hope you like it!

With that out of the way...here's the juicy stuff!

Please welcome our newest Pixels!
Leira
Type: Water
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/b895f0bfe5208011b2356ec22b5d6a51ff5f92ac.gif

Leira is a fast swimmer who can shoot a pressurized water cannon from her mouth. Her species were supposed to be majestic mermaids but something went wrong with her code and this came out.

Lightning Rannala
Type: Brawl
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/9e958d30e8575539c543b59b0b8b1a07ca463ffc.gif

Lightning Rannala is quick on her feet and powerful with her fists! Pixels that underestimate her small stature soon find themselves on the floor, wishing they never taunted her.

Boring Combat...

One of the major problems with combat in Creature Collecting games, is the easy combat. It's super easy to fall into a rhythm of just spamming your most powerful move over and over. Everyone's guilty of it, even me! Games have tried things such as a stamina bar or moves you can only use on certain turns. While we believe those are ok ways to change things up, we decided to put our own spin on things!

Introducing...The Battle Cost System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038199/2966cb078cc1e43224fe8b4ba5dc3ab1c4ad0bfc.png
With our Cost system, you will notice that every move has a cost associated with it. Normally the cost is 1 which is very familiar in other creature collecting games :). However has you start to use the same move over and over, it's cost will go up every time! From 1 to 2 to 3 etc. How do you reduce the cost again? It's simple! Just use a different move and it will be reset back to 1 again! With our cost system we still allow the player to spam moves when desired, but you will definitely feel the consequences as the cost ramps up very quickly! We hope you enjoy it!

Event Tiles!

One of our core Pillars of PIXELS is we wanted every play through to feel different. To help accomplish this, we decided to expand on our mystery tile selection! Currently we have two mystery types implemented, the Secret Shop and the Loot Tile. We added in 3 more to bring our total up to 5! We are committed to expanding this system even further to 10+ types in the future. We hope the unpredictability makes for an exciting experience! Here are the new tile types we added...

Mystery Gateways

3 Doors are in front of you, pick one and see what happens! Hopefully something good!

Reconstructor

Sad with one of the Pixels you got during your run? Use the reconstructor to turn that Pixel into a new one! Hopefully you get something good!

Virtualizer

Some of the feedback we got was from players who wanted a more familar Creature Collecting experience. While the game is a roguelike fusion at heart, we still wanted to add some of those Creature Collecting elements that players love! Introducing, the Virtualizer! With this Machine, you can store a Pixel from your party into the Virtualizer Database! While losing a Pixel make you weaker during your run, your pixel is stored for all future runs. When you encounter another Virtualizer later, you can take a Pixel out and add it to your party! Don't worry though because one the data is stored, it's always for you to use in the future! If you can find another Virtualizer of course. We hope this encourages players to fill up their Virtualizer database and gives players a lot more choice to use the Pixel they desire!


Whew...that was a bunch of stuff. 

Thanks again for following the development of PIXELS! We are still on track for a Q2 Early Access release date and hope to have a release date soon! 

-Jon

notes.title: Pixels will be part of February's Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're proud to annouce that Pixels will be participating in February's Steam Next Fest! Although we are still working hard on the game to get ready for our early access launch, here's a first chance to play the game!

Our demo consists of 2 of our 3 starter Pixels and two of our Stewards to challenge. The demo also has a small group of Pixels to discover on your journey through the virtual world along with some extra secrets to discover. We hope you have fun playing and also we greatly appreciate any feedback you have! Regarding feedback, the best place to leave it is on the game's Steam Discussion page. We will be monitoring it frequently, so if you post anything there, it will definitely be looked at!

We are also going to do livestreams during the event to go a bit more in depth about the game. We will make annoucements for them when we get closer to the beginning of Next Fest!

Regarding save files, this demo is a modified version of the early access release later this year. That being said, we cannot guarantee any sort of compatibility between saves for the demo and the early access version. I know this is a bit of a bummer, but I hope you understand this helps us focus on making the early access launch the best it can be.

We hope you enjoy the Pixels demo and look forward to our release in Q2 of this year!

- Jon
